# dsh-dolphindb
DolphinDB integration for DeepSeek Harness as an installable profile bundle. One package ships the W
ebSocket executor, the model-facing query/write tools, and the 23 bundled DolphinDB skills.

## Skills provenance
The `assets/skills/` trees are vendored from the official `dolphindb/DolphinX_Skill` repository. One
source `SKILL.md` (`dolphindb-daily-factor`) had an unquoted `description` that breaks YAML parsing
; the vendored copy quotes it.
